name: Mark One Metal Works
old_description: Want to be updated with our latest projects and special offers?
about:
Mark One Metal Works was founded in 1996 in Sparks, Nevada, by Mark, a fabricator whose career began in his teens as a transmission mechanic under his father John. After managing the fabrication department at a Peterbilt dealership in Reno, he launched Levco Transmission in 1991 and ran it for 15 years before selling to pursue off-road racing. He then led production at Torchmate, a CNC plasma cutting manufacturer, scaling its output significantly. That blend of machining, fabrication, CAD design, and artistic sensibility led him to establish Mark One Metal Works as a custom metal fabrication and design shop serving the Reno–Sparks area and beyond.

The shop provides a wide range of metalworking services: machining, welding (including TIG), tube bending, CNC plasma cutting on a Lincoln Electric table, and 2D/3D CAD design. It handles both one-off prototypes and production runs, producing items that span industrial fabrications, commercial architectural elements (railings, gates, stairs), residential furniture (desks, tables, doors, fixtures), off-road and hot-rod components, and custom signs, trophies, and awards.

Customers come from commercial construction, residential design, industrial manufacturing, off-road racing, hot-rod building, and the awards/recognition market. The company has fabricated everything from stair railings for commercial buildings to roll cages for UTVs and custom metal furniture for private homes.

Mark One emphasizes exceptional design, unmatched quality, and great customer service, positioning its “unique metal working concepts” and over 30 years of experience as differentiators. The founder’s rare balance of machining, fabrication, CAD, and artistic ability is cited as the reason the shop can take a project from concept to finished product in-house.

name: Market Source Restaurant Supply
old_description: Market Source has provided Oklahoma with top quality food service supplies since 1986. We understand small business and use our personal experience to better serve our customers.
about:
Market Source Restaurant Supply operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where Dick Curtis founded the company in 1986. The Curtis family had been active in the restaurant supply industry since 1945, and Curtis established Market Source, Inc. as a family-owned and operated business to serve the local market.

The company functions as a distributor and retailer of commercial restaurant equipment and supplies, maintaining a 60,000-square-foot showroom and warehouse stocked with more than 10,000 items. It carries product lines from manufacturers such as Vollrath, Saturn, Garland, Tablecraft, Winco, and Hobart, covering categories from cooking equipment and refrigeration to smallwares and tabletop items. In addition to product sales, Market Source provides professional services including kitchen design and layout assistance, custom fabrication, special-order procurement, and nationwide delivery and installation.

The customer base consists primarily of independent restaurants, catering operations, and other food-service businesses in Oklahoma and across the United States through its online store. The company emphasizes a one-stop-shop model, allowing buyers to source everything from major equipment to replacement parts in a single transaction.

Market Source differentiates itself through its family-owned structure, a self-service showroom that enables same-day pickup, and a stated commitment to putting customers first with competitive pricing and personalized service.

name: Marko Foam Products
old_description: Industry Leader in Foam Manufacturing and Packaging Solutions Since 1961.
about:
Marko Foam Products was founded in 1961 in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company has operated continuously from its Utah base for over six decades, though the INPUT does not disclose the founders’ names or ownership structure.

The company manufactures a range of foam-based products, including insulated containers for temperature-sensitive shipping, corner blocks and edge protectors for protective packaging, custom medical packaging for devices and vials, beverage packaging for wines and beers, and expanded polystyrene (EPS) surfboard blanks. Its capabilities encompass foam manufacturing, CNC cutting for prototypes, die-cutting for customizable foam pieces, and packaging fabrication, supported by engineering services.

Marko Foam serves customers in the medical device, beverage, and surfboard industries, as well as businesses requiring temperature-controlled shipping and general protective packaging. Medical clients use its custom solutions for instruments and vials; beverage producers rely on its temperature-maintaining packaging; and surfboard manufacturers source EPS blanks described as 100% recyclable and more durable than alternatives.

The company emphasizes its position as a global supplier of EPS surfboard blanks and highlights the use of recyclable materials and American-made inputs. These attributes, along with its long-standing presence since 1961, are presented as key differentiators in the foam manufacturing and packaging market.

name: Marmon Aerospace & Defense
old_description: with the people and technology that enable the future from Sea to Space.
about:
Marmon Aerospace & Defense Group operates from Manchester, New Hampshire, as a collective of six specialized brands including Marmon Defense, Harbour Industries, Marine Tech Wire & Cable, TE Wire & Cable, KITCO Fiber Optics, and CCPI Europe. The group is a subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway and Marmon Holdings. While the company references over 70 years of collective experience, a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The group manufactures high-performance wire, cable, fiber optic, and connectivity solutions, including mil-spec wire and cable, thermocouple wires and assemblies, fiber optic cable and assemblies, cable assemblies and harnesses, custom engineered cables, and mil-spec kits. It also provides calibration, kitting, training, engineering and design support, thermocouple refurbishment, and field services. Operations span more than 600,000 square feet of manufacturing space with a workforce of over 700 employees and a catalog exceeding 35,000 products.

Customers span commercial aerospace, military aerospace, defense, space, industrial, power generation, naval shipboard, tactical vehicle, and satellite platforms. Specific applications include avionics, C5ISR, electronic warfare, airframe, cabin management, in-flight entertainment, power distribution, and aeroderivative engines for power generation and marine use.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated manufacturing, engineering depth, and a "One Platform" mindset that leverages the combined capabilities of its brands to deliver broader solutions, faster response, and long-term value while maintaining agility.

name: Marne Plastics LLC
old_description: From Initial Planning to Final Production. On time. On budget.
about:
Marne Plastics LLC operates a 58,000-square-foot climate-controlled facility in Grove City, Ohio, in the Columbus region. The company is led by President Mike Fitzsimmons, with Stacey Walmsley as Quality Manager and Natalee Sites as Operations & Warehouse Manager.

The shop runs 18 injection molding machines ranging from 100 to 550 tons, processing materials such as ABS, PP, TPO/TPE, and PA6/PA66 with glass or talc fillers. Services span the full product lifecycle: tool build management for both prototype and production molds, rapid prototyping via 3D printing, and secondary operations including assembly, vibration and hotplate welding, and post-molding embellishment. Quality confirmation relies on an IQMS-driven system with leak testing, dimensional inspection, and automated process monitoring.

Marne serves manufacturers in automotive, consumer goods, and packaging. A major Tier-One automotive supplier, NIFCO, has recognized the company for 100% on-time delivery, and the customer base includes large automotive OEMs alongside diverse industrial clients.

The company emphasizes a nimble, personalized approach, offering one-day lead times on production parts, prototype sampling before contract signing, and a preventative maintenance program designed to reduce mold modifications and overall cost.

name: Marshall Dry Goods Co Inc
old_description: Marshall Dry Goods has been a trusted name in fabric since 1944, proudly serving quilters, retailers, and crafters across the country. Our focus on quality, value, and service has made us a go-to source for wholesale fabrics of all kinds.
about:
Marshall Dry Goods Co., Inc. was founded in 1944 by Hassel Marshall in Batesville, Arkansas. What began as a general dry goods store selling clothing, blankets, and yarn gradually shifted toward fabrics. In 1985, Marshall Bentley and his father, Larry Bentley, took over the business, and Marshall Bentley remains the owner today, having completed the transition to a 100-percent fabric operation.

The company now designs and manufactures its own fabric lines, offering more than 5,000 SKUs with a focus on 100% cotton prints in 45-inch and 108-inch widths. Production uses both conventional rotary and digital printing, supporting a library of over 4,000 exclusive designs that are refreshed weekly. Beyond cotton prints, the mill produces batiks, flannels, minky, fleece, broadcloth, muslin, and quilt batting in 80/20 cotton-polyester, 100% cotton, and 100% polyester blends, available in widths up to 120 inches.

Marshall Dry Goods serves quilters, crafters, and independent retailers across the United States through both wholesale and retail channels. Its wholesale division supplies fabric by the bolt to shop owners, while the online store and the Batesville brick-and-mortar location sell by the yard. The company also operates Marshall’s Quilt House, a retreat space across the street from the main facility.

The business emphasizes quality, value, and fast delivery, a commitment it has maintained through 80 years of operation. The Bentley family’s hands-on involvement in design and manufacturing is cited as the reason the company can introduce new prints weekly while keeping prices competitive.

name: Marshall Food Equipment Service
old_description: Your beloved KitchenAid® stand mixer deserves professional care when it’s not performing at its best. Marshall Food Equipment Service specializes in diagnosing and repairing all Kitchen Aid stand mixer models, ensuring your essential kitchen companion returns to perfect working condition efficiently. We have years of hands-on experience, and we are factory-authorized, so you can trust that we will repair your mixer according to factory specifications. You can count on us to treat your mixer with the same level of care and attention that you do in your kitchen.
about:
Marshall Food Equipment Service has been based in Cranston, Rhode Island since 1928, when it was established in nearby Providence. The family‑owned business has remained in Rhode Island for nearly a century, expanding its service area to include Bristol County, Massachusetts, and New London County, Connecticut.

The company provides commercial food‑service equipment repair, preventive maintenance, and genuine parts supply for cooking, food‑preparation, ware‑washing, and coffee equipment. Its technicians are factory‑trained and CFESA‑certified in gas, electric, steam, and microwave technologies, with many boasting 25‑plus years of field experience. A fully equipped in‑shop facility complements 24/7 on‑site field service, and all work carries a 90‑day warranty on both labor and parts. Marshall also serves as an authorized warranty provider for numerous manufacturers.

Customers range from independent restaurants and cafeterias to healthcare kitchens, bakeries, and institutional food‑service operations. The firm additionally offers factory‑authorized repair for KitchenAid® stand mixers, serving both commercial and residential owners.

The company cites its long history, deep technician experience, manufacturer authorizations, brand‑agnostic service capability, CFESA certification, and round‑the‑clock responsiveness as the factors that distinguish it in the market.

name: Marshfield Furniture
old_description: Since 1944, we have been manufacturing handcrafted, upholstered furniture with quality and integrity in the USA.
about:
Founded in 1944 in Marshfield, Wisconsin, Marshfield Furniture has spent eight decades producing handcrafted upholstered furniture in the United States. The company began as a domestic manufacturer focused on quality and integrity, and remains headquartered in its namesake city.

The company manufactures living, dining, and bedroom collections that are built to order. Its production line offers over 75 frame styles and more than 500 fabric choices, plus 48 leather options, allowing each piece to be customized to individual taste. Every item is handcrafted in the company's Wisconsin facility, with an emphasis on zero-defect construction.

Marshfield Furniture sells exclusively through a network of authorized retail dealers across the United States. Its customers are primarily furniture retailers and, ultimately, residential consumers seeking made-to-order upholstered pieces. The company partners with these dealers to deliver special-order furniture that reflects current styles from transitional to modern and rustic lodge.

The firm's stated mission centers on operational excellence and accountability, aiming to produce high-value, zero-defect furniture that delights the end user. Leadership emphasizes that they want the customer to return, not the product, a philosophy that drives their focus on durability and long-term relationships with suppliers and dealers.

name: Martech Medical Products Inc
old_description: To be the leading solution provider for every customer we serve. To drive sustainable growth of our business through the continued investment in our people, technology and quality while delivering world class products and services.
about:
Martech Medical Products operates from Harleysville, Pennsylvania, with a second facility in Mexicali, Mexico. The company was founded in 1978 and initially built its reputation as a supplier of high-quality extrusions and molded components for the medical device industry.

Today Martech provides concept-to-production services across three manufacturing and engineering sites totaling 200,000 square feet and employing over 2,000 people. Its internal capabilities span R&D, project management, 3D printing, tool design, extrusion, molding, tipping, printing, coating, drilling, machining, assembly, packaging, and sterilization, enabling finished catheter and silicone product manufacturing under one roof.

The company serves top medical device manufacturers worldwide, with a historical focus on catheter-based solutions such as epidural and hemodialysis catheters. Its customer base includes firms requiring both small-scale development and large-volume production.

Martech emphasizes its ability to handle projects of any size, offering services that smaller companies lack and larger companies prefer not to allocate internally. By integrating every phase — from design conception through FDA validations to shipping — it positions itself as a single-source partner that reduces production costs and accelerates timelines.

name: Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment
old_description: As a busy professional, you can count on Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment for a huge assortment of products, the lowest prices, and superior customer service from our showroom-based staff.
about:
Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment was founded in 1997 in Reisterstown, Maryland. The company operates a showroom and warehouse serving the Mid-Atlantic region, focusing on medical supplies and equipment for healthcare providers.

The business distributes a broad assortment of medical supplies and equipment through its local warehouse, showroom, and online store. Its staff assists healthcare professionals with product selection and ordering, aiming to simplify procurement for facilities ranging from small practices to larger institutions. The company does not manufacture products but stocks a wide range of items from various manufacturers.

The company serves doctor’s offices, clinics, rehabilitation centers, nursing homes and assisted‑living communities, and physical‑therapy practices throughout Maryland and surrounding areas. Customers can order online, by phone, or visit the Reisterstown showroom for hands‑on evaluation. The firm also refers consumers to a separate retail site for personal purchases.

Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment emphasizes its local warehouse as a differentiator, enabling faster delivery to Maryland customers compared to distant online retailers. The company also highlights its trained showroom staff who help clients navigate product choices, a service it has provided since its founding in 1997. The business positions itself as a partner that removes guesswork from purchasing decisions.
